cta.title: Monte Carlo, in SQL
cta.description: Install Stochastic to compute PDFs, CDFs, quantiles, and random samples from 36 named probability distributions inside DuckDB, fit distributions to your columns, and run t-tests, chi-squared and Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests — Monte Carlo, synthetic data and inference without leaving the warehouse.

quickStart.title: Find a normal-distribution percentile
quickStart.description: Calculate the 95th percentile of a standard normal distribution, then check its cumulative probability.
quickStart.sql:
SELECT round(dist_normal_quantile(0.0, 1.0, 0.95), 4) AS p95,
       round(dist_normal_cdf(0.0, 1.0, 1.6448536269514722), 2) AS probability;
quickStart.note: The parameters describe a standard normal distribution: mean 0 and standard deviation 1. This computes a theoretical quantile, not a percentile of an observed table.

quickStart.title: Fit a distribution and test the fit
quickStart.description: Fit a gamma distribution to a column by maximum likelihood, then check the fit with a Kolmogorov-Smirnov test.
quickStart.note: The fit returns a STRUCT whose fields are named like the distribution's parameters, so it plugs straight into the other dist_gamma_* functions, followed by the log_likelihood, aic and bic for comparing fits. Fitting and the tests need the DuckDB 2.0 build of the extension.

introduction.title: Calculate probabilities and draw samples in SQL
paragraphs: Stochastic provides 36 probability distributions through a consistent set of SQL functions. For each one you can evaluate a density, calculate a cumulative probability or quantile, read its properties and generate random samples.

It also works in the other direction: fit aggregates estimate a distribution's parameters from a column by maximum likelihood, and test aggregates run Kolmogorov-Smirnov, t-tests and Pearson's chi-squared test next to your data. Use it for synthetic datasets, probability calculations alongside existing rows, simulation experiments and quick inference.
